title: Excellence Hubs
source: EU Funding & Tenders / European Research Executive Agency
beneficiaries: At least two R&I ecosystems from two different Widening countries. Each ecosystem includes academia, business, public authority and societal actors. Non-Widening legal entities may join if necessary to achieve expected impacts.
eligible_cost_note: General Horizon Europe CSA eligible-cost rules apply; the call funds 70% of eligible costs. The proposal must explain how the remaining 30% will be secured and shared.
constraints: quadruple-helix composition for each Widening ecosystem
Italian participation must be justified as necessary
recommendation: Join an existing Widening-country consortium as industrial/technology partner rather than coordinate.
